camera: Lower frontal view with converging depth; ordinary small-world-scale foreground buildings appear larger; distant monumental civic architecture recedes. No equal-scale isometric miniatures.
canon_boundary: The named Riot landmarks are canonical reference subjects. The compressed town composition, individual service/dwelling buildings and their exact positions are project adaptations, not a map of canonical capital districts.
composition: Sixteen ordinary land sites, seven replacement dwelling sites and nine civic/service sites. Optional coastal shipyard is seventeenth; Grail is an ornament within civic site.
geometry_status: Provisional layout boxes for production only; do not treat rectangular guides as game art or accepted click masks.
plate_rules: New river/escarpment geography inspired by Demacian civic forms.
Bare plate must leave functional buildings absent until constructed.
No imported Royal Palace, Galio, Grand Plaza crowds or walls baked into a fully built background.
Light upper-left, weathered pale petricite, muted blue roofs/cloth, steel and restrained gold.

blacksmith.role: World-scale small workshop, very large because foreground

defenses.role: Rear military gatehouse and wall complex

duelist.role: Fencing academy with single attached court

mageseeker.role: Melee order HQ with suppression tower integrated

market.role: Cohesive foreground market hall and attached awnings

status: built-unreviewed; sixteen-site low-frontal composition and all35selected construction states compiled; native acceptance pending
style_authority: Original Heroes III Castle at native resolution; subject references never replace its rendering/perspective rules.
user_direction: Buildings and town look should take inspiration from The Great City of Demacia.
vegetation: Sparse edge shrubs/trees only. Use full width with paved civic terraces, streets and connected plots; no large unused forest or central grass field.
visibility: Building library upgrade chains govern replacement. Ship is a conditional vessel, not an ordinary constructed replacement for Shipyard. Grail remains a separate special state.
